title: Therapeutic potential of Banxia-Houpu Decoction in alleviating inflammation and myocardial injury in chronic intermittent hypoxia models.
authors: Song, Ji-Xian; Shan-Xu; Han, Hong-Yu; Sun, Meng-Fan; Meng-Xu; Zhao, Ya-Shuo; Guo, Ya-Jing; Ji, En-Sheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究半夏厚朴汤在慢性间歇性缺氧心肌损伤中的抗炎作用，虽含分子对接但核心为中药药效与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) can result in chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH), which triggers an inflammatory response. Banxia-Houpu Decoction (BHD) has been reported to ameliorate cardiac injury induced by OSA. The aim of this study was to elucidate the molecular basis and therapeutic role of BHD in CIH-induced myocardial injury. AIM: The aim of this study was to investigate the therapeutic potential of BHD in the treatment of OSA by examining its bioactive components, target genes, molecular interactions, pathways, and therapeutic efficacy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: C57BL/6 N mice were randomly divided into control, CIH, BHD-L (7.02 g/kg/d) and BHD-H (14.04 g/kg/d) groups. The mice were exposed to CIH (21-5 % O(2), 20 times/h, 8 h/d) for 28 d. An aqueous extract of BHD was analysed using LC-MS/MS. Cardiac function, network pharmacology, inflammation levels, apoptosis, and molecular docking were analysed. RESULTS: BHD significantly reduced cardiac function impairment and cardiac enzyme levels caused by CIH. Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF1-alpha) was identified as a therapeutic target through network pharmacology and gene transcriptomics. BHD downregulated HIF1-alpha expression and inhibited the transition of macrophages from the M2 phenotype to the M1 phenotype by increasing CD163 expression while downregulating inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and CD68 levels. BHD decreased pro-inflammatory factor levels and increased anti-inflammatory factor levels. Finally, the results of molecular docking and kinetic simulations demonstrated that the active components of BHD effectively bind to HIF1-alpha. CONCLUSION: These findings highlight that BHD attenuates CIH-induced cardiomyocyte-mediated inhibition of the HIF1-alpha-inflammatory pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）可导致慢性间歇性缺氧（CIH），从而触发炎症反应。半夏厚朴汤（BHD）已被报道可改善OSA诱导的心脏损伤。本研究旨在阐明BHD在CIH诱导的心肌损伤中的分子基础及治疗作用。目的：本研究旨在通过检测BHD的生物活性成分、靶基因、分子相互作用、通路及治疗效果，探讨其在OSA治疗中的潜力。材料与方法：将C57BL/6 N小鼠随机分为对照组、CIH组、BHD-L（7.02 g/kg/d）组和BHD-H（14.04 g/kg/d）组。小鼠暴露于CIH（21-5% O(2)，20次/小时，8小时/天）持续28天。使用LC-MS/MS分析BHD水提物。评估心脏功能、网络药理学、炎症水平、凋亡及分子对接。结果：BHD显著减轻了CIH引起的心脏功能损伤和心肌酶水平升高。通过网络药理学和基因转录组学，缺氧诱导因子1-α（HIF1-alpha）被确定为治疗靶点。BHD下调HIF1-alpha表达，并通过增加CD163表达同时下调诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和CD68水平，抑制巨噬细胞从M2表型向M1表型的转变。BHD降低了促炎因子水平，并增加了抗炎因子水平。最后，分子对接和动力学模拟结果表明，BHD的活性成分能有效结合HIF1-alpha。结论：这些发现强调，BHD通过抑制HIF1-alpha炎症通路，减轻CIH诱导的心肌细胞介导的损伤。
